description: This file defines the OutboundEmail class responsible for managing outbound email accounts within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting outbound email configurations, as well as handling system default accounts and user-specific overrides.

classes.name: OutboundEmail
classes.description: Class responsible for managing outbound email configurations including retrieval, creation, updates, deletions, and permissions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OutboundEmail instance and sets up the database connection.

methods.name: getUsersMailerForSystemOverride
methods.description: Retrieves the system override outbound email for a specific user.

methods.name: createUserSystemOverrideAccount
methods.description: Creates a new system override outbound email account for a user with specified credentials.

methods.name: doesUserOverrideAccountRequireCredentials
methods.description: Checks if a user's override account needs to have credentials set.

methods.name: getUserMailers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of outbound email accounts available to a specific user, including system defaults and user overrides.

methods.name: getUserMailerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the outbound mailer settings for a user based on optional mailer ID or inbound email ID.

methods.name: getAssociatedInboundAccounts
methods.description: Returns IDs of inbound email accounts associated with this outbound email.

methods.name: getInboundMailerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves inbound email settings based on mailbox ID or inbound email ID, with fallback to system account.

methods.name: isAllowUserAccessToSystemDefaultOutbound
methods.description: Determines whether a user is permitted to use the system default outbound email account.

methods.name: getSystemEmail
methods.description: Fetches the system outbound email configuration if available.

methods.name: getSystemMailerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the system outbound email configuration.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Populates the current OutboundEmail object with data from the database based on ID.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the object properties from POST request data.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Prepares and returns sanitized values for database insertion or update.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the outbound email configuration to the database, either creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: saveSystem
methods.description: Saves the configuration as the system outbound email account, updating settings accordingly.

methods.name: updateUserSystemOverrideAccounts
methods.description: Synchronizes user override accounts with the system account if permissions allow.

methods.name: removeUserOverrideAccounts
methods.description: Deletes all user override outbound email accounts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this outbound email record from the database.

methods.name: _getOutboundServerDisplay
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display string for the SMTP server based on its type.

methods.name: getMailerByName
methods.description: Retrieves an outbound email configuration by its name, considering user permissions.

methods.name: checkSavePermissions
methods.description: Verifies if the current user is authorized to save the outbound email configuration, throws exception if not.
